name: onui
description: Browser extension for annotating UI elements for AI agents

scripts.build:all: pnpm --filter @onui/core build && pnpm --filter @onui/mcp-server build && pnpm --filter @onui/extension build
scripts.test:all: pnpm --filter @onui/core build && pnpm --filter @onui/mcp-server run test && pnpm --filter @onui/extension test
scripts.test:coverage: pnpm --filter @onui/core build && pnpm --filter @onui/mcp-server run test:coverage && pnpm --filter @onui/extension test:coverage
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @onui/core build && pnpm --filter @onui/core typecheck && pnpm --filter @onui/mcp-server run typecheck && pnpm --filter @onui/extension typecheck
scripts.check: pnpm typecheck && pnpm test:all && pnpm build:all
